articleTitle: Rotor Modal Suppression in Active Magnetic Bearing System Based on Frequency-Locked-Loop Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Modal vibration of rotor seriously affects stability of magnetic bearing system. Once the rotor mode is excited, the vibration intensifies, which is easy to lead to the saturation of the power amplifier and further instability of the rotor system. The paper investigates a rotor modal suppression method based on frequency-locked-loop filter. The dynamic model of single-degree-of-freedom rotor is established. A frequency-locked-loop filter is added to the closed loop control system to estimate the modal frequency and suppress modal vibration. The proposed frequency locked loop can estimate all components of biased sinusoidal signals. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method for rotor modal suppression.

articleTitle: Research on storage and compression method of time series data in cement production
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The phenomenon of data redundancy and large occupation of storage space is easy to be caused, because the cement production process is continuous and short cycle, resulting in a large number of production process timing data. Furthermore, this phenomenon will make the data can not be utilized effectively. According to the data feature and alteration frequency, this paper designs the corresponding storage compression method based on technology about sub-table storage, the periodic compression and changed-storage compression which can effectively optimize the data storage space and improve the data application efficiency.

articleTitle: Fast Candidate Region Extraction for SAR Ship Target
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: At present, deep learning technology is widely used in ship target detection in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images. However, high-resolution remote sensing SAR images cover a larger area and have larger image sizes. To be able to use the deep learning model for training and testing, the image needs to be cropped to the appropriate size. In a high-resolution SAR ship image, the ship target usually takes only a small part of the whole image. As a result, only part of the cropped image contains the target, and most of the rest are background regions. This will cause a lot of computational redundancy in the model inference stage. To solve this problem, a fast candidate region extraction algorithm is proposed in this paper for ship target extraction. The algorithm consists of three parts: firstly, extract the saliency map of the SAR ship image, secondly, perform median filtering on the segmented image, and thirdly, extract candidate regions. The superiority of the algorithm was demonstrated by experiments on the AIR-SARShip-1.0 dataset.

articleTitle: Research on maintenance scheme model of mine pipeline and equipment based on particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The operation status of mine pipeline and equipment affects the safe production of coal mines. At present, the wear prediction of pipeline equipment in mines at home and abroad is mainly based on threshold prediction, and the periodic maintenance plan lacks judgment standard. To solve the above problems, this paper presents a maintenance scheme model of mine piping equipment based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm, and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method. Particles are encoded according to the actual degree of wear corresponding to the maintenance scheme. Each particle represents a prediction of the pipeline equipment maintenance scheme. The PSO scheme has fast convergence speed and achieve easily. Compared with manual experience, this method can quickly find the optimal scheme of all possible schemes, optimize the preparation and scheduling of maintenance resources, reduce costs, greatly improve the efficiency of mine maintenance, and provide decision support for the formulation of maintenance schemes.

articleTitle: A distributed event-triggered algorithm for optimisation problem with a designable minimum inter-event time
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the optimization problem of multi-agent systems, a zero-gradient-sum optimization algorithm based on event-triggered control is designed to reduce the update frequency of controller and the communication burden between agents. Under the proposed distributed optimization algorithm, the states of all agents asymptotically converge to the global optimal value without using any global information. In addition, Zeno behavior can be avoided, and the minimum inter-event time can be designed. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Fast Evaluation of Distribution Network Reliability Based on Topology
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper designs a model that can quickly evaluate the security of distribution network. By extracting the distribution network features, the distribution network feature vectors are formed, and the vectors are quickly clustered to obtain the distribution network security evaluation results. In this paper, the topology theory is innovatively introduced into the research of distribution network, and it is found that the topology of distribution network can measure the security of distribution network well, and the accuracy of distribution network can be obtained quickly and accurately by using this method.

Author Keywords: Topology structure of continuous space-time power grid
Reliability and fault soft self-healing model of distribution network topology

articleTitle: EAS Sign-Stability of Dual Switching Linear Continuous-Time Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates exponentially almost-sure stability (EAS stability) of dual switching linear continuous-time systems, in which only the sign of the subsystem matrices are known. This is a qualitative approach to stability analysis called sign-stability. The notion of sign-stability is natural extensions of standard EAS stability. It is called EAS sign-stability. It is remarkable the qualitative notion of stability is verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Time-varying output-constrained vibration control of multiple-sectioned flexible marine riser
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we aim to reduce the vibration of an asymmetric output constraint multiple-sectioned marine riser system having external time-varying disturbances. The riser system’s dynamics can be described by a number of successively connected partial differential equations (PDEs) and an ordinary differential equation (ODE) additional with assuming continuity constraints condition. We build a novel disturbance observer to evaluate boundary disturbance that are unknown and meanwhile barrier Lyapunov functions are employed to guard against the violation of time-varying constraint. Stem from Lyapunov-based control coped with the back-stepping technology, a boundary controller is put forward to realize the control objectives. In addition, the closed-loop system’s stability and uniform boundedness are strictly guaranteed. In the end, simulations verifies the validity of the designed control scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Method of Urban Underground Cable Partial Discharge Defects
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: After the urban underground power transmission cable is put into use, the cable section is prone to metal residue, semiconductor residue, insulation moisture and other defects when the cable joint is connected, resulting in partial discharge phenomenon of the cable. This paper analyzes the partial discharge of cable, proposes a convolutional neural network to identify the local discharge signal, and improves the network to obtain better results. This topic has a wide range of application scenarios and is suitable for the identification and analysis of cable discharge signals generated during cable operation.

articleTitle: Dense 3D Reconstruction SLAM Algorithm Based on Improved Keyframe Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of SLAM algorithm such as low location accuracy and easy loss of tracking, we propose a dense 3D reconstruction SLAM algorithm based on improved keyframe selection. The algorithm introduces an inferior keyframe elimination method, eliminates the selected inferior keyframes, and uses a bidirectional indexing keyframe strategy to supplement new high-quality keyframes to express the current scene, thus improving the localization accuracy of the algorithm. At the same time, we add the dense mapping thread to the traditional SLAM algorithm, and pass the selected keyframes into the dense mapping thread to build a dense map that can accurately describe the location information of objects in the scene through 3D point cloud stitching. The algorithm proposed in this paper is tested with the publicly available TUM dataset, and the test results show that the algorithm has a 13.3% reduction in absolute trajectory error compared with the ORB-SLAM2 algorithm, which shows good mapping capability.

articleTitle: Study on The Dilemmas and Ability Improvement of University Experimental Teaching Staff under The Background of Double First-class
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Experimental teaching staff is an integral part of colleges and universities under a “double first-class” background. This paper analyses the current situation of the number of undergraduates in Regular HEIs and postgraduates in China and the current situation of university experimental teaching staff under the “double first-class” background. Taking the School of Automation of the Wuhan University of Technology as an example, this paper analyzes the needs of experimental teaching staff, discusses the dilemmas and challenges faced by them, and gives corresponding suggestions based on existing policies.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Consensus Control for Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems Based on PDE With Actuator Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A class of nonlinear multi-agent systems (MASs) with Spatio-temporal properties is described using partial differential equation(PDE) in this paper, and fault-tolerant control of such systems is further investigated. The adverse effects of faults on the system are compensated by constructing a fault-tolerant control protocol (FTCP), which is based on the information interaction between neighboring agents and a general actuator failure model. Finally, a numerical example verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: SOC Estimation of LiFePO4 Battery with Dual Adaptive Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The traditional unscented kalman filter (UKF) algorithm is used to estimate the state of charge (SOC) of the lithium battery, it has better estimation effect, and less amount of calculation. However, this algorithm also has its limitations, It can only be used when the statistical properties of observation noise and process noise are known. This paper proposes an adaptive unscented Kalman filter (AUKF) algorithm to solve these problems based on an adaptive algorithm and an unscented kalman filter strategy. The AUKF can use the noise statistical estimator to revise the unknown or inaccurate noise statistical properties in real time. According to the experimental results, it has been shown that the AUKF stronger convergence speed and stability than the traditional UKF.

articleTitle: Lung Segmentation Network Based on Lightweight and Attention Fusion with U-Net
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional U-Net network is bloated, the amount of calculation and the amount of parameters are too large. We fuse the improved depthwise separable convolution of the lightweight network. In order to suppress the influence of background pixels in the image on the segmentation effect, attention gates are introduced to highlight the target area containing key information. We propose a MAU-Net network structure. It is verified by using the LUNA competition lung image dataset. When the calculation amount and parameter amount of the network are reduced by about 78% and 87% respectively compared with the original traditional U-Net. The LOSS of the experimental results on the test set is 0.012, the Accuracy reaches 0.992, and the IOU is 0.961, which is 1.5% higher than the traditional U-Net’s Accuracy, and the evaluation index IOU is improved by 1.9%. It is proved that the improved MAU-Net network has better effect on lung parenchyma segmentation.

articleTitle: Towards Pose Estimation for Large UAV in Close Range
publicationTitle: 2022 37th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of 4D pose estimation for large unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in close range. A sensor system consisting of one single point laser range-finder and two cameras is designed and a novel pose estimation method based on vision fusion and point cloud registration is proposed. Our approach works on one-shot mode and only requires 10 samples with real poses for template construction. Through V-rep simulation environment, we generate two 200-sample datasets of different difficulty for evaluation. Error quantiles, 5cm5deg and 10cml0deg are three evaluation metrics used in our ablation experiments. It is illustrated that our method outperforms in robustness and precision due to proposed dimension extension modification and fusion of vision sensors.
